user.t:
Create a founder's OPERATIONS & TOOLING STACK (what to subscribe to / set up to run the company) for the five ventures under C:\Users\mariu\ventures\ (freight-recovery, subrogation-recovery, withholding-tax-reclaim, provider-data-accuracy, contract-to-cash-leakage). Founder is Norway-based (AS). Use WebSearch where budget allows; cite + grade A/B/C and FLAG prices as indicative/변 (they change; many have free tiers). This is a doc task — no code. No ruflo/ruvnet.

HONESTY FIRST — include a "Build vs Buy" section at the top: BUY the commodity stuff (comms, CRM, HR/payroll, accounting, cap-table) — do NOT build your own; building internal versions of these is a waste. Only "internal tooling worth building" = the venture product itself + maybe a thin internal admin/ops dashboard (note it, don't over-scope). Also a STAGED ADOPTION note: at pre-seed use free tiers + the legal minimum; add paid tools after the raise — don't pay for everything day one.

CANONICAL STACK (shared across all five) — list concrete well-known vendors per category with rough price tiers + free-tier flags:
- Comms & collaboration (Slack/Teams/Discord; Google Workspace vs Microsoft 365; Notion/Confluence; video).
- Code/DevOps (GitHub already in use; CI already in repos; error monitoring Sentry; uptime; secrets; cloud = AWS already chosen; IaC already in repos).
- CRM & sales (HubSpot free tier, Attio, Pipedrive) + outreach.
- Support/ticketing (for when customers arrive).
- HR / people / payroll — NORWAY-SPECIFIC: Norwegian payroll + A-melding to Skatteetaten (Tripletex, Huldt & Lillevik, or via accountant), HR info systems; contractor vs employee.
- Accounting / finance — NORWAY-SPECIFIC: Fiken / Tripletex / PowerOffice (or Xero/QuickBooks), expense tools, business banking (DNB etc. or fintech), MVA/VAT via Altinn.
- Cap table / equity / shareholders — the AS legally requires an aksjeeierbok (share register); tools: Carta, Pulley, Ledgy (EU), or a simple register at seed; option-scheme admin.
- Board / governance — generalforsamling (AGM) + board minutes, a board portal for later; a shared data room (for diligence) — Google Drive/Notion at seed, a real VDR (Datasite/Ansarada) for a raise/sale.
- Legal / contracts — templates + a Norwegian advokat at seed; CLM (Ironclad/Juro) later; e-signature (DocuSign/Signant/BankID).
- Compliance / security — GDPR/DPA tooling (EEA), a privacy tool, and the third-party security audit vendor (the raise funds this).
- Company formation / registry — Brønnøysundregistrene via Altinn; registered address; accountant.
- Analytics / product (PostHog/Plausible) + data.
- Project/task mgmt (Linear/Jira/Notion).

PER-COMPANY DELTAS — a short section per venture for industry-specific tools/compliance: provider-data-accuracy (healthcare/HIPAA-adjacent: a HIPAA-capable vendor set + BAAs), subrogation (insurance + claims-data/privacy), withholding-tax (cross-border tax data/providers), freight + contract-to-cash (commercial/procurement — lighter).

OUTPUT: write the canonical doc + the 5 per-company versions to C:\Users\mariu\AppData\Local\Temp\claude\C--Users-mariu\8f3352b3-40ab-4151-abc9-d1de1978973c\scratchpad\ops-stack\ . Then COMMIT an `ops/tooling-stack.md` into the FOUR repos EXCEPT freight-recovery (subrogation-recovery, withholding-tax-reclaim, provider-data-accuracy, contract-to-cash-leakage) and `git push origin HEAD` each. Do NOT touch freight-recovery (a production-foundation build is running there — leave its copy in scratchpad and say so). Keep the honest framing (recommendations not endorsements; prices indicative; verify current pricing + Norwegian payroll/accounting rules with your accountant). Return a concise summary.

handback.t:

**Caveat on sources:** the WebSearch budget (200/200) was already used up, so every price and Norwegian-rule claim comes from my background knowledge and was not verified against a live page today. The doc says this at the top and says to confirm with your accountant and a Norwegian advokat. The A/B/C grades mark what kind of source to check before acting. They are not fetched citations. A closing section lists the pages to confirm against: Altinn, brreg, Skatteetaten, Lovdata, Datatilsynet, vendor price pages, and AWS's HIPAA/BAA page.

- **13 category tables** with vendors, rough price tiers, free-tier flags and grades:

  - Norwegian payroll and a-melding, contractor vs employee, accounting (Fiken, Tripletex, PowerOffice), bank, MVA via Altinn

- **First-90-days purchase order.**
- **Per-venture deltas:** provider-data-accuracy (BAAs and HIPAA-capable vendor set), subrogation-recovery, withholding-tax-reclaim, and freight-recovery plus contract-to-cash-leakage (lighter).
